analysis:
Integration across all 54 units found no concrete security regression in the supplied evidence. The PR is a documentation edit set, a bump of three MLX submodule pins (libs/mlx, libs/mlx-swift, libs/mlx-swift-lm), and mechanical provider and test adaptations to the new SDK API. The doc edits are date bumps and the GatedDelta.swift path move to MLXLMCommon (hardware-support.md:702, inference.md:609, cli-reference.md:1816, configuration.md:441). The adaptations are: module-qualified MLXLLM.Gemma4AssistantDraftModel and Gemma4TextConfiguration; `LanguageModel.prepare(state:prefill:)`, including the GLM5NextProtectedExecution.swift:144-149 wrapper, which still runs requireInput (the enforced-context bound) before delegating; `.source` unwrapping in MediaIngest.swift:422 and MiMoV26EncodedMediaIngress.swift:252; a throwing reKeyedQwenTargetWeights (EngineV2VLMTextExtraction.swift:166,258-264) that fails closed into the engine_v2_refusal load failure; a throwing newCache in the benchmark ThroughputSweep; and the benchmark ignoring .rejectedToolCall.

The main limit is that the submodule diffs are not supplied. The pointer bumps (mlx ad4745a2 to ff4bb35b, mlx-swift 67dc7528 to eedca444, mlx-swift-lm 6148b6da to 476cb7c0) change in-process inference code, Metal kernels and the metallib, which run on decrypted prompts and KV state (TB-007, T-028, A-001). They could also affect cache behavior (T-041) and the build identity and qualification of the signed artifact (T-013, T-034, T-054, TB-011).

Open items for deeper review:
1. Confirm the upstream changes leave the prefix-cache and KV semantics, the weight-sanitize error handling, and the memory contract intact.
2. Confirm the production handling of the new Generation.rejectedToolCall event in the serving path (ProviderLoop and tool-stream code). Only the benchmark handling is visible here. The serving path must neither drop it silently nor emit plaintext.
3. Confirm `image.source` and `video.source` still cover the .ciImage case, so the post-decode aggregate pixel recheck at MediaIngest.swift:422-433 still runs, and that the memory-backed video guarantee (T-050) holds.
4. Confirm the platform-side signed-artifact qualification is refreshed for the new metallib and binary. This is outside this repo's scope.
No findings are raised, because none of this is supported by visible evidence.
